ModMetadata.Name: RockingDice's Stationpedia Craftable Products
ModMetadata.Author: RockingDice
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]RockingDice's Stationpedia Craftable Products[/h1] [b]See what each material can be used to manufacture.[/b]
This mod adds a Craftable section after the original Used In section on Stationpedia material pages. It reads every manufacturing recipe currently loaded by the game.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*]Lists every product that can be manufactured from the current material. [*]Shows the product icon, machine, tier, energy, conditions, and complete material requirements. [*]Sorts simpler recipes and shorter processing chains first. [*]Opens the product's Stationpedia page when its icon is selected. [*]Reuses the original scrolling area and material links without changing recipes, items, or save data. [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*]BepInEx 5 [*]StationeersLaunchPad [/list]
Installation guide: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
[h2]Compatibility[/h2] This release was built and verified against Stationeers 0.2.6403.27689, BepInEx 5.4.23.5, and StationeersLaunchPad 0.5.0.
[h2]Source Code[/h2] https://github.com/rockingdice/Stationeers-Craftable-Products
[h2]AI Disclosure[/h2] The code, text, and Workshop artwork were created with generative AI assistance under the author's direction and tested in game by the author.
[h1]中文说明[/h1] [b]在百科材料页反查“这些材料可以制造什么”。[/b]
本 Mod 在原版“使用于”之后增加“可制造”分组，并直接读取游戏当前加载的全部制造配方。
[h2]主要功能[/h2] [list] [*]显示可由当前材料制造的全部产物。 [*]显示产物图标、制造机器、等级、能量、条件和完整材料需求。 [*]优先排列材料更少、加工链更短的简单配方。 [*]点击产物图标可直接打开对应百科页。 [*]复用原版滚动区域与材料链接，不修改配方、物品或存档。 [/list]
[h2]运行要求[/h2] [list] [*]BepInEx 5 [*]StationeersLaunchPad [/list]
安装说明：https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
[h2]兼容性[/h2] 本版本针对 Stationeers 0.2.6403.27689、BepInEx 5.4.23.5 和 StationeersLaunchPad 0.5.0 构建并验证。
[h2]源码[/h2] https://github.com/rockingdice/Stationeers-Craftable-Products
[h2]AI 说明[/h2] 本 Mod 的代码、文本和创意工坊封面在作者指导下使用了生成式 AI 辅助，并经过作者实机测试。
